# Kaiwen Design System (LLM Specification)

> Production-grade, modular design system and component library for Kaiwen Web and Mobile.

## Packages
- `@kaiwen/tokens`: Semantic tokens for colors, spacing, radius, typography, motion, z-index.
- `@kaiwen/ui-web`: Web component library (Button, Input, Card, Skeleton, Stack, Box, Text, etc.).
- `@kaiwen/ui-native`: React Native component library with native keyboard/gesture behaviors.
- `@kaiwen/icons`: Tree-shakable SVG icon set.
- `@kaiwen/brand`: Kaiwen Logo, Wordmark, and Mark glyphs.
- `@kaiwen/utilities`: Shared classname merger (cn), SSR safety, a11y helpers.

## Design Character
- Modern, minimal, quiet, high contrast, clean typography.
- Primary palette: Black, White, Neutral Grays, subtle accent status colors.
- Micro-animations: smooth, subtle, fast (120ms-180ms), with reduced motion support.

## Web Example
```tsx
import { ThemeProvider, Button, Card, Stack, Input, Text } from "@kaiwen/ui-web";

export function LoginView() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="dark">
      <Card padding="lg">
        <Card.Header title="Sign in" subtitle="Enter your credentials" />
        <Stack gap="md">
          <Input label="Email" type="email" placeholder="name@domain.com" />
          <Button variant="primary" fullWidth>Continue</Button>
        </Stack>
      </Card>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Native Example
```tsx
import { KaiwenThemeProvider, Button, Card, Stack, Input, Text } from "@kaiwen/ui-native";

export function NativeLoginView() {
  return (
    <KaiwenThemeProvider initialTheme="dark">
      <Card>
        <Card.Header title="Sign in" subtitle="Mobile Authentication" />
        <Stack gap="md">
          <Input label="Email" keyboardType="email-address" autoCapitalize="none" />
          <Button variant="primary" fullWidth>Continue</Button>
        </Stack>
      </Card>
    </KaiwenThemeProvider>
  );
}
```
